question: How many days would 1,000 chips at 100 trillion operations a second take to train 70 billion adjustable numbers on 1.4 trillion word-pieces?
move: Price a big job by its unit cost times its count before guessing.
trap: Counting one operation per number per word-piece instead of about six.
hint: Each word-piece read in training costs about six operations for every adjustable number.
steps: About 6 operations per number per word-piece: 6 × 70 billion × 1.4 trillion ≈ 5.9 × 10^23.
reference: Hoffmann et al., Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models, arXiv:2203.15556, 2022
